draft.headline: Jake White’s Fiji debut: A Tokyo rematch five weeks on
beats: Just five weeks after Japan beat Fiji 20–15 to claim the Pacific Nations Cup, the two sides return to Prince Chichibu Memorial Stadium for an Anniversary Test.
This clash marks the debut of World Cup-winning head coach Jake White, who has been tasked with bringing South African discipline and clear structures to the Flying Fijians.
Fiji have been sharpening their combinations at the D-Rocks Rugby Club this week, aiming to improve a 2026 form guide that has seen them lose four of their five tests.
While Japan enter on a three-match winning streak, Fiji are looking for revenge after their narrow defeat on this same Tokyo ground in September.
The rankings are on a knife-edge: a Fiji victory would see them leapfrog Japan into 9th place, while a home win would see the visitors tumble below Wales and Italy to 12th at best.
